mappingNote: Green centers are OpenStreetMap polygon centroids; numbered routes compared with official hole diagrams and the archived USGS aerial. Retrieved 2026-10-26. No on-course survey or daily pin data. Ratings, yardages and main men's stroke indexes follow the course's current downloadable scorecard, not older third-party cards. The separate women's stroke-index row is not represented by the app schema. Archival aerial imagery may predate course changes. Live yardages use coordinates, not printed tee lengths.
